application.name: RelayDesk — Cross-Team Service Request Platform
application.architecture: Server-backed Node 24 + native node:sqlite + React 19 / Vite 6
modules: Shared Platform — Role Authorization, SLA Tracking, Webhooks, Audit

gate_a_baseline_ready.details: BRAD v0.5.0 baseline passed 54/54 tests. BMAD Method v6.12.4 + TEA v1.27.2 workspace files installed in bmad-workspace, but active AI host skill catalog discovery was not registered at session startup.

gate_b_runnable_application.details: Node 24 server + native node:sqlite + React 19 / Vite 6 web client runnable. 16/16 server integration tests pass.

gate_c_development_collaboration.details: 3 Git worktrees active with 10 collaboration exercises and conflict resolution a8a757d completed. Independent multi-agent cycle (Developer 0e1296d6 -> Reviewer 735f91db -> QA 4c6f5dda -> Developer remediation -> QA signoff) executed on REQ-B7 with commits ae6d892, 542e522, and merge 0804ac9.

gate_d_qa_and_sdlc.details: 22 functional acceptance scenarios verified. Defects DEF-101 and DEF-102 (CRITICAL) verified fixed and closed with 16/16 automated tests. Acceptance criteria gatekeeper verified.

gate_e_brad_validation.details: Canonical 85 routing cases audited. Contract and target resolution passed. 42 exact routes selected, 43 conditional routes require human/policy review and cannot be counted as passes. L4 native invocation blocked at host boundary.

gate_f_improvement_verification.details: 3 confirmed findings implemented in isolated candidate branch (candidate/v0.5.1-improvements): doctor installCommand, increment-aware routing, review-only safety. 55/55 tests pass.

gate_g_final_package.details: Sanitized demo example, offline self-contained MASTER_REPORT.html, telemetry events, and honest decision package prepared.

verdict_rationale: Application foundation, Git multi-worktree mechanics, genuine independent multi-agent collaboration, QA defect lifecycle, 85-case routing audit, and candidate improvements were verified. Native BMAD invocation remains BLOCKED at the active host boundary, and conditional routes are strictly distinguished from verified execution passes.
